details.subject: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident timeline, Aug 3 2026
details.body:
Hi Odile,

Here is the timeline for the Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident on Aug 3, 2026, as recorded in #inc-vtg-hartford (times as shown in the channel):

10:42 AM  First report: gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
10:51 AM  Carrowmere Cloud checking the Hartford gateway route; kiosk 2 to be left powered on for reconnect attempts.
11:03 AM  Kiosk 1 back.
11:07 AM  Both lanes working (reported 11:08 AM).

Still open at the time of the last update: a separate status-page access issue, tracked in INC-4821.

Gideon Sato
Pemberline Systems
